questions.question: The sum of the squares of two consecutive even natural numbers is 1924. The sum of the numbers is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let the middle odd number between the two consecutive even numbers be n.

The numbers can be written as (n − 1) and (n + 1). Their sum is 2n.

Given: (n − 1)² + (n + 1)² = 1924

⇒ 2(n² + 1) = 1924 ⇒ n² + 1 = 962 ⇒ n² = 961 ⇒ n = 31

The sum of the two numbers is 2n = 2 × 31 = 62.

**∴ The correct answer is 62.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The sum of the squares of two consecutive even natural numbers is 1924.

**Calculations:**

Let the two consecutive even natural numbers be x and x + 2.

⇒ x² + (x + 2)² = 1924

Using the identity (a + b)² = a² + 2ab + b²:

⇒ x² + x² + 4x + 4 = 1924

⇒ 2x² + 4x + 4 − 1924 = 0

⇒ 2x² + 4x − 1920 = 0

Divide the entire equation by 2 to simplify:

⇒ x² + 2x − 960 = 0

Factorizing the quadratic equation by splitting the middle term:

⇒ x² + 32x − 30x − 960 = 0

⇒ x(x + 32) − 30(x + 32) = 0

⇒ (x − 30)(x + 32) = 0

⇒ x = 30 or x = −32

Since the question specifies natural numbers, we ignore the negative value and take x = 30.

The consecutive even numbers are 30 and 32.

⇒ Sum of the numbers = 30 + 32 = 62

**∴ The correct answer is 62.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Consecutive Numbers

Consecutive even or odd numbers always have a common difference of 2. They can be generally represented as x and x + 2 to set up algebraic equations.

Simplifying Sum of Squares

When calculating the sum of squares of two consecutive numbers differing by 2, assuming them as (n − 1) and (n + 1) simplifies the equation to 2(n² + 1), canceling out the linear terms completely.

Nature of Roots

A quadratic equation ax² + bx + c = 0 yields two roots. In practical word problems involving natural numbers, dimensions, or time, negative or fractional roots are discarded.
</p

questions.question: If a regular polygon has 15 sides, then what is the measure (in degrees) of each interior angle?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

For any regular polygon, the exterior angle is directly calculated as 360° ÷ number of sides.

⇒ Exterior Angle = 360° ÷ 15 = 24°

The interior and exterior angles always form a linear pair (sum = 180°).

⇒ Interior Angle = 180° − Exterior Angle

⇒ Interior Angle = 180° − 24° = 156°

**∴ The correct answer is 156°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of sides of the regular polygon (n) = 15

**Formula Used:**

Sum of interior angles of an n-sided polygon = (n − 2) × 180°

Each interior angle = [(n − 2) × 180°] ÷ n

 

 

 
• 
 

 
 
 
 Interior = 156°
 Exterior = 24°
 Sum of Interior & Exterior Angle = 180°

**Calculations:**

⇒ Each interior angle = [(15 − 2) × 180°] ÷ 15

⇒ Each interior angle = [13 × 180°] ÷ 15

⇒ Each interior angle = 13 × 12°

⇒ Each interior angle = 156°

**∴ The correct answer is 156°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Sum of Interior Angles

For a polygon with *n* sides, the sum of all interior angles is given by **(n − 2) × 180°**.

Sum of Exterior Angles

The sum of exterior angles of any convex polygon is always **360°**, regardless of the number of sides.

Number of Diagonals

The number of diagonals that can be drawn in an *n*-sided polygon is given by **n(n − 3) ÷ 2**.
</p

questions.question: Salil got an increase of 4% in his sales amouant in the first year and 24% in the second year; also with this, his current sales are ₹1,61,200, what was his sales (in ₹) two years ago?

questions.question: Evaluate: (−9) − (−60) ÷ (−12) + (−2) × 8
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

According to the BODMAS rule, perform division and multiplication first:

(−60) ÷ (−12) = 5

(−2) × 8 = −16

Substitute these results back into the original expression:

⇒ −9 − 5 − 16 = −30

**∴ The correct answer is -30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

(−9) − (−60) ÷ (−12) + (−2) × 8

**Concept Used:**

BODMAS Rule: Priority of mathematical operations follows the order Bracket, Order, Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

**Calculations:**

⇒ (−9) − [(−60) ÷ (−12)] + [(−2) × 8]

⇒ −9 − (5) + (−16)

⇒ −9 − 5 − 16

⇒ −14 − 16

⇒ −30

**∴ The correct answer is -30.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

It specifies the correct order of operations to solve a mathematical expression: Brackets, Order (powers and roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

Sign Convention for Multiplication and Division

The product or quotient of two numbers with the same sign (both negative or both positive) is always positive. The product or quotient of one positive and one negative number is always negative.

Sign Convention for Addition

When adding numbers with the same sign, you simply add their absolute values and keep the common sign. For example, −A − B = −(A + B).
</p

questions.question: Anjani can do a certain piece of work in 30 days. Anjani and Khushbu can together do the same work in 16 days, and Anjani, Khushbu and Sushmita can do the same work together in 15 days. In how many days can Anjani and Sushmita do the same work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM of 30, 16, and 15 = 240 units.

Efficiency of Anjani (A) = 240 ÷ 30 = 8 units/day.

Efficiency of (A + K) = 240 ÷ 16 = 15 units/day, and (A + K + S) = 240 ÷ 15 = 16 units/day.

Efficiency of Sushmita (S) = 16 − 15 = 1 unit/day.

Time taken by A + S = 240 ÷ (8 + 1) = 240 ÷ 9 = 80/3 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 80/3 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by Anjani (A) = 30 days.

Time taken by Anjani and Khushbu (A + K) = 16 days.

Time taken by Anjani, Khushbu, and Sushmita (A + K + S) = 15 days.

**Formula Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time taken

Efficiency is inversely proportional to time.

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 A

 240 ÷ 30 = 8
 
 

 A + K

 240 ÷ 16 = 15
 
 

 A + K + S

 240 ÷ 15 = 16
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Efficiency of Sushmita (S) = Efficiency of (A + K + S) − Efficiency of (A + K)

⇒ Efficiency of S = 16 − 15 = 1 unit/day

⇒ Efficiency of Anjani (A) = 8 units/day

⇒ Combined efficiency of Anjani and Sushmita (A + S) = 8 + 1 = 9 units/day

⇒ Time taken by A and S together = Total Work ÷ Combined Efficiency

⇒ Time taken = 240 ÷ 9 = 80/3 days

**∴ The correct answer is 80/3 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Pipes & Cisterns

Similar to the time and work concept, an inlet pipe has a positive filling efficiency while an outlet pipe (or leak) has a negative emptying efficiency. Time to fill = Total Capacity ÷ Net Efficiency.

Work & Wages

Total wages are distributed strictly in proportion to the actual amount of work done by each individual. If they work for the exact same number of days, the wages are divided in the ratio of their efficiencies.

Alternate Day Work

When individuals work on alternate days, find the total work done in one complete cycle (e.g., 2 days for 2 people) and divide the total work by the cycle work to find the number of full cycles needed.
</p

questions.question: A sum of money triples itself at a certain rate of compound interest in 5 years. In how many years will it amount to 9 times of itself?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In compound interest, if a sum becomes 'x' times in 'T' years, it will become xⁿ times in n × T years.

Given, the sum becomes 3 times in 5 years.

We need to find the time it takes to become 9 times, which is 3² times.

Here, x = 3, T = 5 years, and n = 2.

Required time = n × T = 2 × 5 = 10 years.

**∴ The correct answer is 10 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 P

 
 3P

 
 9P

 

 5 years
 × 3

 

 5 years
 × 3
 
 

 Total Time = 10 years

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

**Given:**

Amount becomes 3 times the principal in 5 years at compound interest.

**Formula Used:**

A = P(1 + R/100)t

**Calculations:**

⇒ 3P = P(1 + R/100)⁵

⇒ 3 = (1 + R/100)⁵ ... (Equation 1)

We need to find the time 't' when the amount becomes 9P.

⇒ 9P = P(1 + R/100)t

⇒ 9 = (1 + R/100)t

Since 9 = 3², we can substitute the value of 3 from Equation 1.

⇒ ((1 + R/100)⁵)² = (1 + R/100)t

⇒ (1 + R/100)¹⁰ = (1 + R/100)t

By comparing the powers on both sides:

⇒ t = 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10 years.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Simple Interest vs Compound Interest

In Simple Interest, the principal remains constant. In Compound Interest, the interest generated is added back to the principal to form a new base for the next compounding period.

Compound Interest Formula

A = P(1 + R/100)t, where A is the Final Amount, P is the Principal sum, R is the Rate of interest per annum, and t is the time period in years.

Multiplying Factor in CI

For equal time intervals, the amounts in compound interest are in a geometric progression. The ratio between amounts over any equal continuous time intervals remains strictly constant.
</p

questions.question: A shopkeeper lists the price of a fan at 36% above its cost price and offers a 25% discount on its list price. If he earns a profit of ₹171, then what is the list price (in ₹) of the fan?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let Cost Price (CP) = 100%, then Marked Price (MP) = 136%.

Selling Price (SP) after 25% discount = 136% × 0.75 = 102%.

Profit = SP − CP = 102% − 100% = 2%.

Given 2% = ₹171 ⇒ MP (136%) = 171 × 68 = ₹11,628.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹11,628.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 
 

 
 

 
 CP = 100x

 
 SP = 102x

 
 MP = 136x

 

 +36% Markup

 

 Profit = 2x

 

 −25% Discount

Given:

⇒ Markup percentage = 36%

⇒ Discount percentage = 25%

⇒ Profit earned = ₹171

Let the Cost Price (CP) of the fan be 100x.

⇒ Marked Price (MP) = 100x + 36% of 100x = 136x

⇒ Selling Price (SP) = MP − 25% of MP = 136x × 0.75 = 102x

⇒ Profit = SP − CP = 102x − 100x = 2x

According to the given data, profit is ₹171:

⇒ 2x = 171

⇒ x = 85.5

⇒ List Price (MP) = 136x = 136 × 85.5 = 11,628

**∴ The correct answer is ₹11,628.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

1. Discount and Marked Price

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price (List Price). Formula: Selling Price (SP) = Marked Price (MP) × (1 − Discount%/100).

2. Relation between CP and MP

When Profit percentage and Discount percentage are given, the direct ratio is: CP / MP = (100 − Discount%) / (100 + Profit%).

3. Successive Discounts

When two successive discounts of a% and b% are applied, the net equivalent discount is given by: [a + b − (a × b)/100]%.

questions.question: Which of the following numbers divides 788973289?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To check divisibility by 7, 11, and 13 simultaneously, group the digits into blocks of three from right to left.

The blocks of 788973289 are: 788, 973, 289.

Difference between the sum of odd-placed blocks and even-placed blocks = (788 + 289) − 973 = 1077 − 973 = 104.

Since 104 is exactly divisible by 13 (13 × 8 = 104), the entire number is perfectly divisible by 13.

**∴ The correct answer is 13.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 788973289

**Method Used:**

Test each option systematically using standard divisibility rules.

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Option 1 (18):** A number divisible by 18 must be even. Since 788973289 ends with the digit 9, it is an odd number and not divisible by 18.

⇒ **Option 2 (12):** A number divisible by 12 must be divisible by 4 (hence even). Thus, it is not divisible by 12.

⇒ **Option 3 (7) and Option 4 (13):** Apply the block divisibility rule for 7, 11, and 13.

⇒ Split the number into groups of three digits from right to left: 289, 973, 788.

⇒ Sum of alternating groups = 788 + 289 = 1077.

⇒ Difference = 1077 − 973 = 104.

⇒ Check divisibility of 104 by 7: 104 ÷ 7 = 14 with a remainder of 6. So, not divisible by 7.

⇒ Check divisibility of 104 by 13: 104 ÷ 13 = 8 with a remainder of 0. So, it is divisible by 13.

⇒ Therefore, 788973289 is exactly divisible by 13.

**∴ The correct answer is 13.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Divisibility Rule of 7, 11, and 13

Make groups of 3 digits starting from the rightmost digit. Find the difference between the sum of the odd-placed groups and the even-placed groups. If this final difference is divisible by 7, 11, or 13, then the original number is also perfectly divisible by 7, 11, or 13 respectively.

Divisibility Rule of 12

A number is divisible by 12 if it is perfectly divisible by both 3 and 4. Consequently, any number divisible by 12 must be an even number.

Divisibility Rule of 18

A number is exactly divisible by 18 if it is an even number (ends in 0, 2, 4, 6, 8) and the sum of its digits is a multiple of 9.
</p

questions.question: ₹15,500 were divided among A, B and C, such that 7 times the share of A = 4 times the share of B = 2 times the share of C. Find the share of A.
questions.solution:

Given 7A = 4B = 2C, we can find the ratio using the cover-up method.

A : B : C = (4 × 2) : (7 × 2) : (7 × 4)

Total parts = 4 + 7 + 14 = 25 parts

A's share = (4 ÷ 25) × 15500 = 4 × 620 = 2480

questions.question: Simplify the following. 9 × (19 × (4²)) ÷ 14 + 13 - 86
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Apply the BODMAS rule directly to the expression to solve quickly:

⇒ 9 × (19 × 16) ÷ 14 + 13 − 86

⇒ 9 × 304 ÷ 14 − 73

⇒ 2736 ÷ 14 − 73 ⇒ 1368/7 − 73

⇒ (1368 − 511) / 7 ⇒ 857/7

**∴ The correct answer is 857/7.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression: 9 × (19 × (4²)) ÷ 14 + 13 − 86

**Formula Used:**

BODMAS Rule: Follow the strict sequence of Brackets, Orders (powers), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction.

**Calculation:**

Solve the innermost bracket (power) first:

⇒ 9 × (19 × 16) ÷ 14 + 13 − 86

Solve the remaining bracket (multiplication):

⇒ 9 × 304 ÷ 14 + 13 − 86

Perform multiplication next:

⇒ 2736 ÷ 14 + 13 − 86

Perform division and simplify the fraction:

⇒ 1368/7 + 13 − 86

Perform subtraction of integers first for easier calculation:

⇒ 1368/7 − 73

Take the lowest common multiple (LCM) to subtract the integer from the fraction:

⇒ (1368 − 73 × 7) / 7

⇒ (1368 − 511) / 7

⇒ 857/7

**∴ The correct answer is 857/7.**

**__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

BODMAS dictates the correct order of operations in math: Brackets, Orders (powers/roots), Division, Multiplication, Addition, and Subtraction. Expressions must be evaluated strictly in this sequence to avoid calculation errors.

Fraction Simplification

When adding or subtracting whole numbers and fractions, convert the whole number to a fraction by taking the LCM of the denominators to combine the terms effectively.

Rules of Exponents

An exponent signifies repeated multiplication of the base. For example, a² = a × a. Always calculate the exponent before attempting multiplication or division connected to it.
</p

questions.question: A person purchased a gift article for ₹1,800 after getting 20% discount. Find the marked price of the gift article.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

A discount of 20% is equivalent to a fraction of 1/5.

This means if the Marked Price is 5 units, the Selling Price is 4 units (5 − 1).

Given, 4 units = ₹1,800.

1 unit = 1800 ÷ 4 = ₹450.

Marked Price (5 units) = 5 × 450 = ₹2,250.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,250.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling Price (SP) of the gift article = ₹1,800

Discount percentage given on the article = 20%

**Formula Used:**

SP = MP × [(100 − Discount%) ÷ 100]

 
 
 

 
 
 
 MP = ?
 100% (Base)
 
• 
 20% Discount
 
 SP = ₹1,800
 80% of MP
 80% = ₹1,800 → 100% = ₹2,250

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the Marked Price of the article be MP.

⇒ 1800 = MP × [(100 − 20) ÷ 100]

⇒ 1800 = MP × (80 ÷ 100)

⇒ 1800 = MP × (4 ÷ 5)

⇒ MP = (1800 × 5) ÷ 4

⇒ MP = 450 × 5

⇒ MP = 2250

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,250.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Marked Price (MP) vs Cost Price (CP)

Discount is always calculated on the Marked Price set by the shopkeeper, whereas Profit or Loss is calculated on the actual Cost Price.

Successive Discounts

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are given on an article, the equivalent single discount percentage is (a + b − ab ÷ 100)%.

Direct Relation Formula

The direct ratio of Cost Price to Marked Price can be represented using the formula: CP / MP = (100 − Discount%) / (100 + Profit%).

questions.question: Which of the following numbers divide 342165?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

To find the divisor quickly, check the divisibility rule for 3.

Sum of digits of 342165 = 3 + 4 + 2 + 1 + 6 + 5 = 21.

Since 21 is exactly divisible by 3, the number 342165 is also divisible by 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number = 342165

**Concept Used:**

Divisibility rules of numbers.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let us check the divisibility rules for the given values:

⇒ **Divisibility by 2:** The given number ends in 5, which is an odd digit. Hence, it is not divisible by 2.

⇒ **Divisibility by 4:** A number is divisible by 4 if its last two digits form a number divisible by 4. Here, the last two digits are 65. Since 65 is not completely divisible by 4, the number is not divisible by 4.

⇒ **Divisibility by 7:** Dividing the number manually: 342165 ÷ 7 = 48880 with a remainder of 5. Since the remainder is not 0, it is not divisible by 7.

⇒ **Divisibility by 3:** A number is exactly divisible by 3 if the sum of all its digits is a multiple of 3.

⇒ Sum of digits = 3 + 4 + 2 + 1 + 6 + 5 = 21.

⇒ 21 ÷ 3 = 7 (exactly divisible).

⇒ Therefore, the number 342165 is completely divisible by 3.

**∴ The correct answer is 3.**

Divisibility by 6

A number is divisible by 6 if it successfully satisfies the divisibility rules of both 2 and 3.

Divisibility by 9

A number is divisible by 9 if the sum of all its individual digits is a multiple of 9.

Divisibility by 11

A number is divisible by 11 if the difference between the sum of its digits at odd positions and the sum of its digits at even positions is either 0 or a multiple of 11.

questions.question: The LCM of the numbers 3.8 and 0.052 is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Convert the given decimals into simplified fractions:

3.8 = 38/10 = 19/5

0.052 = 52/1000 = 13/250

Formula: LCM of fractions = LCM of Numerators ÷ HCF of Denominators

⇒ LCM(19, 13) ÷ HCF(5, 250) = 247 ÷ 5 = 49.4

**∴ The correct answer is 49.4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

The numbers are 3.8 and 0.052.

**Concept Used:**

To find the LCM of decimals, equate the number of decimal places by appending zeros, compute the LCM of the integer values without decimals, and then place the decimal point back at the same original position.

**Calculations:**

⇒ Make the decimal places equal: 3.8 becomes 3.800 and 0.052 remains 0.052.

⇒ Treat the numbers as integers by ignoring the decimals: 3800 and 52.

⇒ Prime factorization of 3800 = 2³ × 5² × 19

⇒ Prime factorization of 52 = 2² × 13

⇒ LCM(3800, 52) = Product of the maximum power of each prime factor

⇒ LCM(3800, 52) = 2³ × 5² × 13 × 19 = 8 × 25 × 13 × 19

⇒ LCM(3800, 52) = 200 × 247 = 49400

⇒ Place the decimal point 3 places from the right (as there are 3 decimal places in 3.800 and 0.052).

⇒ Final LCM = 49400 ÷ 1000 = 49.4

**∴ The correct answer is 49.4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

LCM of Fractions

The LCM of two or more fractions is calculated as: LCM = LCM of Numerators ÷ HCF of Denominators. Always ensure the fractions are reduced to their simplest form before applying the formula.

HCF of Fractions

The HCF of two or more fractions is calculated as: HCF = HCF of Numerators ÷ LCM of Denominators.

LCM of Decimals

Make the number of decimal places identical by appending zeros to the right end. Compute the LCM of the integer values ignoring the decimal point completely, then put the decimal point back to match the equalized decimal places in the final result.
</p

questions.question: If sin θ + cosec θ = 2, then the value of sin¹²⁰θ + cosec¹²⁰ θ is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If x + 1/x = 2, then x = 1.

Since cosec θ = 1 / sin θ, the given equation is sin θ + 1 / sin θ = 2.

This implies sin θ = 1 and cosec θ = 1.

For any power n, sinⁿθ + cosecⁿθ = 1ⁿ + 1ⁿ = 2.

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

sin θ + cosec θ = 2

**Formula Used:**

cosec θ = 1 / sin θ

**Calculation:**

⇒ sin θ + (1 / sin θ) = 2

Let sin θ = x. Then the equation becomes:

⇒ x + 1/x = 2

Multiplying both sides by x:

⇒ x² + 1 = 2x

⇒ x² − 2x + 1 = 0

⇒ (x − 1)² = 0

⇒ x = 1

Since x = sin θ, we have sin θ = 1.

⇒ cosec θ = 1 / sin θ = 1 / 1 = 1

Now, substitute these values into the required expression:

⇒ sin¹²⁰θ + cosec¹²⁰θ

⇒ (1)¹²⁰ + (1)¹²⁰

⇒ 1 + 1 = 2

**∴ The correct answer is 2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Algebraic identity x + 1/x = −2

If x + 1/x = −2, then x = −1. For this case, xⁿ + 1/xⁿ will be 2 if n is even, and −2 if n is odd.

Similar Trigonometric Pairs

This property applies to other reciprocal trigonometric ratios. If cos θ + sec θ = 2, then cos θ = 1 and sec θ = 1. Similarly, if tan θ + cot θ = 2, then tan θ = 1 and cot θ = 1.

Algebraic identity x + 1/x = k

If x + 1/x = k, then x² + 1/x² = k² − 2, and x³ + 1/x³ = k³ − 3k.
</p

Average of Consecutive Numbers

questions.question: Simplify: x(3x - 7) + 7(x² -4) + 18
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Directly expand the brackets using the distributive property:

⇒ x(3x − 7) + 7(x² − 4) + 18

⇒ 3x² − 7x + 7x² − 28 + 18

Combine the like terms (x², x, and constant):

⇒ 10x² − 7x − 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10x² − 7x − 10.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Expression = x(3x − 7) + 7(x² − 4) + 18

**Calculations:**

⇒ Multiply x inside the first bracket: x × 3x − x × 7 = 3x² − 7x

⇒ Multiply 7 inside the second bracket: 7 × x² − 7 × 4 = 7x² − 28

⇒ Substitute these expanded values back into the full expression:

⇒ 3x² − 7x + 7x² − 28 + 18

⇒ Group the like terms together:

⇒ (3x² + 7x²) − 7x + (−28 + 18)

⇒ 10x² − 7x − 10

**∴ The correct answer is 10x² − 7x − 10.**

**__Additional Information__**

Distributive Property

The distributive property states that a(b + c) = ab + ac. It is used to multiply a single term with two or more terms inside a set of parentheses.

Like Terms

Like terms are terms that contain the exact same variables raised to the exact same powers. Only like terms can be combined by addition or subtraction.

BODMAS Rule

Always solve mathematical expressions in the exact order of Brackets, Orders (powers and roots), Division or Multiplication, and lastly Addition or Subtraction.
</p

questions.question: By selling 6 buttons for a rupee, a man loses 45%. To gain 10% how many must he sell for a rupee?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When the total amount is constant, the quantity sold is inversely proportional to the selling price percentage.

⇒ Q₁ × (100 − Loss%) = Q₂ × (100 + Gain%)

⇒ 6 × (100 − 45) = Q₂ × (100 + 10)

⇒ 6 × 55 = Q₂ × 110

⇒ Q₂ = 330 ÷ 110 = 3

**∴ The correct answer is 3 buttons.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Selling price (SP₁) of 6 buttons = 1 Rupee

Loss percentage = 45%

Desired gain percentage = 10%

**Calculations:**

⇒ SP₁ of 1 button = 1 ÷ 6 Rupee

⇒ Since the man loses 45%, SP₁ = (100 − 45)% of CP = 55% of CP

⇒ 55% of CP = 1 ÷ 6

⇒ CP = (1 ÷ 6) × (100 ÷ 55) = 10 ÷ 33 Rupee

⇒ To gain 10%, the new selling price (SP₂) = (100 + 10)% of CP = 110% of CP

⇒ SP₂ of 1 button = (110 ÷ 100) × (10 ÷ 33)

⇒ SP₂ of 1 button = (11 ÷ 10) × (10 ÷ 33) = 11 ÷ 33 = 1 ÷ 3 Rupee

⇒ Thus, the selling price is 1 Rupee for 3 buttons.

**∴ The correct answer is 3 buttons.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Price and Consumption Relation

When the total amount spent is constant, the quantity of items purchased is inversely proportional to their price. Thus, Q₁ × P₁ = Q₂ × P₂.

Successive Discount

If two successive discounts of a% and b% are offered, the effective net discount is given by [a + b − (a × b) ÷ 100]%.

Dishonest Dealer

If a dealer sells goods at cost price but uses a false weight, his profit percentage is given by [(True Weight − False Weight) ÷ False Weight] × 100%.
</p

questions.question: A man goes to Indore from Bhopal at a speed of 12 km/hr and returns to Bhopal at speed of 24 km/hr, through the same route. What is his average speed (in km/hr) of the entire journey?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

When equal distances are covered at speeds x and y, the average speed is given by the direct formula:

Average speed = 2xy ÷ (x + y)

Here, x = 12 km/hr and y = 24 km/hr.

Average speed = (2 × 12 × 24) ÷ (12 + 24)

Average speed = 576 ÷ 36 = 16 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 16 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
 
• 
 
 Bhopal
 Indore
 
 

 

 Speed = 12 km/hr
 
 

 

 Speed = 24 km/hr
 
 Distance = 24 km (LCM)

**Given:**

Speed from Bhopal to Indore (S₁) = 12 km/hr

Speed from Indore to Bhopal (S₂) = 24 km/hr

**Calculation:**

Let the one-way distance between the two cities be the LCM of the given speeds to simplify calculations.

⇒ LCM of 12 and 24 = 24 km

⇒ Time taken to reach Indore = Distance ÷ S₁ = 24 ÷ 12 = 2 hours

⇒ Time taken to return to Bhopal = Distance ÷ S₂ = 24 ÷ 24 = 1 hour

⇒ Total distance covered for entire journey = 24 + 24 = 48 km

⇒ Total time taken = 2 + 1 = 3 hours

⇒ Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

⇒ Average Speed = 48 ÷ 3 = 16 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 16 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Equal Time Intervals

If a person travels at speeds x and y for equal amounts of time, the average speed is simply the arithmetic mean: (x + y) ÷ 2.

Average Speed for Three Equal Distances

If equal distances are covered at three different speeds x, y, and z, the average speed formula is: 3xyz ÷ (xy + yz + zx).

Relative Speed

When two objects move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (x + y). In the same direction, it is the difference (x − y).
</p

questions.question: The number of prime numbers lying between 411 and 424, both included, is:
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

In the range 411 to 424, ignore all even numbers and numbers ending in 5.

The remaining odd candidates are 411, 413, 417, 419, 421, and 423.

Eliminate multiples of 3 using the sum of digits trick: 411, 417, and 423 are divisible by 3.

Test the remaining numbers (413, 419, 421) for divisibility by 7: 413 = 7 × 59.

The only remaining numbers are 419 and 421, both of which are prime.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 prime numbers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Range of numbers: 411 to 424 (both included)

**Method Used:**

To check if a number N is prime, we test divisibility by all prime numbers up to √N. Here, √424 ≈ 20, so we check divisibility by 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17, and 19.

**Calculations:**

⇒ All even numbers in the range (412, 414, 416, 418, 420, 422, 424) are divisible by 2 and thus not prime.

⇒ 415 is divisible by 5 and thus not prime.

⇒ Check divisibility of the remaining odd numbers by 3, 7, 11, 13, 17, and 19:

⇒ 411 ÷ 3 = 137 (Not prime)

⇒ 413 ÷ 7 = 59 (Not prime)

⇒ 417 ÷ 3 = 139 (Not prime)

⇒ 419 is not divisible by any prime up to 19 (Prime)

⇒ 421 is not divisible by any prime up to 19 (Prime)

⇒ 423 ÷ 3 = 141 (Not prime)

⇒ The prime numbers in the given range are 419 and 421.

**∴ The correct answer is 2 prime numbers.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Prime Number

A natural number greater than 1 that is only divisible by 1 and itself.

Twin Primes

A pair of prime numbers that have a difference of exactly 2. For example, 419 and 421 form a pair of twin primes.

Prime Testing Rule

To determine if a number N is prime, you only need to systematically test for divisibility by prime numbers up to the square root of N (√N).
</p
